readingUncertainties: The BOS-MAD return (CV154, 03:10Z-10:40Z) is printed as 09SEP, but 09SEP also carries a DO row and 08SEP is absent from the roster entirely. A date cannot be both a flight and a day off, and the header's Days Off: 10 is only satisfied if the 09SEP DO is genuine. I therefore read the CV154 row as 08SEP (a printing error in the Date column) and all four header totals then reconcile. If instead the DO were the error, the crew would have a two-night BOS stop and the days-off count would be 9, contradicting the header.
